examples.name: JS Canvas Game Bounce
examples.description: Playable 2D canvas bounce game using MALDA game.* API (arrow keys + animation loop)
examples.learningGoal: Branch the browser track into playful interactive programming.
examples.expectedOutput: Runs a simple playable 2D bounce game in the browser.

examples.name: JS Canvas Sprite Smoke
examples.description: PNG atlas blit, scrolling camera, setCameraZoom, drawImageEx flip/rotate, pushCamera HUD, and a click-to-world marker
examples.learningGoal: Show image handles, atlas source rects, a 2D camera with zoom, drawImageEx flip/rotate, and world-space mouse on the canvas path.
examples.expectedOutput: Pans and zooms a PNG tileset with arrow keys, draws atlas frames plus a spinning and a flipped tile, and places a world marker on click.

examples.name: JS Canvas Input Smoke
examples.description: Key press/release edges, mouse click edges, multi-touch, and gamepad axes using MALDA game.* input APIs
examples.learningGoal: Show wasKeyPressed/wasKeyReleased, wasMousePressed, getTouches, and gamepad helpers on the canvas path.
examples.expectedOutput: Moves with arrows or the left stick, jumps once per Space tap or click, and follows the first touch.

examples.name: JS Canvas Collision Smoke
examples.description: Inclusive AABB/circle overlap plus sweepRect CCD against a thin gate using MALDA game.* collision APIs
examples.learningGoal: Show overlapRect, overlapCircle, pointInRect, pointInCircle, and sweepRect on the canvas path.
examples.expectedOutput: Moves a box into a wall and a circle; the box turns pink on overlap. A fast dart stops on the thin gate; the ghost shows the tunneled end pose.

examples.name: JS Canvas Tile Helpers Smoke
examples.description: drawTiles atlas blit, tileAt cell query, and sweepTiles landings on a 2D id grid using MALDA game.* APIs
examples.learningGoal: Show Pico-8-style map draw/query plus swept tile collision without a Tiled importer.
examples.expectedOutput: Runs a tiny tile cave: green cells are solid, magenta gems collect via tileAt, and the player lands with sweepTiles.

examples.name: JS Canvas Sample SFX Smoke
examples.description: Overlapping WAV one-shots with game.audioPlaySample that leave the Audio v1 pattern running
examples.learningGoal: Show audioPlaySample / audioStopSample overlapping file hits without stopping the v1 pattern or track.
examples.expectedOutput: After Space/click to unlock audio, Z and X play two beeps that overlap; S stops the hi sample; A stops samples only.

examples.name: JS Canvas Fixed Timestep + Save Smoke
examples.description: game.startFixed catch-up ticks plus a high score that survives reload via game.save/load
examples.learningGoal: Show startFixed(update, render, tickMs) and origin-scoped save/load without copying a dt clamp.
examples.expectedOutput: A box moves at a fixed tick. Space raises score and high score; reload keeps the high score. R resets score; D deletes the save.

examples.name: JS Canvas Platform Showcase
examples.description: Short side-scroller that uses images, camera, swept AABB, key edges, sample SFX, startFixed, spinning coins, and a facing player
examples.learningGoal: Show G1–G5 game.* helpers in one playable side-scroller that still compiles with --mode js.
examples.expectedOutput: Runs a short platformer: atlas tiles, camera follow, sweepRect landings, spinning coins, a player that faces left/right, jump/coin SFX, and a high score that survives reload.

examples.name: JS Canvas Ray Tracer
examples.description: Simple CPU ray tracer (spheres, ground plane, shadows) using game.setPixel and game.blitPixels
examples.learningGoal: Show that MALDA JavaScript mode can write a full-frame pixel buffer and blit it in one ImageData upload.
examples.expectedOutput: Renders a progressive CPU ray-traced scene in the browser.

examples.name: JS three.js GPU Ray Tracer
examples.description: Realtime GLSL sphere tracer with tinted glass and a mirror ball, using three.createShaderMaterial and three.setUniform
examples.learningGoal: Show how a CPU MALDA tracer becomes realtime by moving the rays into a curated three.js GLSL shader.
examples.expectedOutput: Renders a realtime GPU ray-traced scene in the browser.

examples.name: JS three.js Path Tunnel
examples.description: ShaderToy-style GPU path-marching tunnel converted to @shader() kernels (Frostbyte, CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0)
examples.learningGoal: Show a ShaderToy-style volumetric path march written as typed MALDA @shader() functions and compiled with glsl.compile.
examples.expectedOutput: Renders a realtime GPU tunnel that flies along a twisting path.

examples.name: JS Canvas Game Maldanoid
examples.description: Arkanoid-style breakout on the primitive-draw track: calmer aimed serves, velocity-axis brick bounces, combo bar, shaped power-ups, and a saved high/combo blob
examples.learningGoal: Show a full breakout on fillRect/fillCircle that still uses the post-kit game.* loop, overlap helpers, and save/load.
examples.expectedOutput: Runs a richer breakout-style browser game: near-vertical serve, HP bars on bricks, combo meter, and a high score plus best combo that survive reload.

examples.name: JS Canvas Game Maldadash
examples.description: Boulder Dash-style cave: dig dirt, drop boulders, collect diamonds, and dodge fireflies using MALDA game.* API
examples.learningGoal: Show a grid-and-physics cave game on the same game.* canvas path as Bounce and Maldanoid.
examples.expectedOutput: Runs a playable Boulder Dash-style cave in the browser.

examples.name: JS three.js Rotating Cube
examples.description: Minimal 3D browser demo using MALDA three.* helpers with a lit cube and animation loop
examples.learningGoal: Introduce MALDA's 3D browser path with a small but visually rich example.
examples.expectedOutput: Renders a rotating 3D cube in the browser.

examples.name: JS three.js Textured Cube + glTF
examples.description: PNG material map, runtime-owned glTF load, and camera lookAt using MALDA three.* helpers
examples.learningGoal: Show createTexture map, loadGLTF, and lookAt on the curated three.* path without a fourth script tag.
examples.expectedOutput: Renders a spinning textured box beside a glTF cube; the camera looks at the pair.

examples.name: JS three.js Maldanoid 3D
examples.description: Playable breakout-style 3D demo using MALDA three.* helpers with a lit arena, animated bricks, and browser controls
examples.learningGoal: Provide a high-ceiling browser/3D showcase after the learner has seen smaller JS-target examples.
examples.expectedOutput: Runs a playable 3D breakout-style browser demo.
